serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-compliance-checker
serverInfo.description: MCP server that checks KVKK, GDPR, and CCPA compliance for websites via the GuardBee API

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Run a full compliance scan for a URL against a regulatory framework (KVKK, GDPR, or CCPA) using the GuardBee scanner. Returns a gap analysis and action plan.

url.description: Target URL to audit for compliance

framework.description: Regulatory framework: KVKK, GDPR, or CCPA

wait.description: Wait for scan to complete (default: true)

tools.name: get_compliance_findings
tools.description: Get compliance findings from a completed GuardBee scan, optionally filtered by severity

scanId.description: Scan ID from check_compliance or start_scan

framework.description: Framework label for the report header

tools.name: analyze_privacy_policy
tools.description: Fetch and analyze a privacy policy page for completeness against GDPR/KVKK requirements. Works without an API key.

url.description: Direct URL to the privacy policy page (or homepage to auto-detect)

tools.name: list_requirements
tools.description: List all compliance requirements for a framework with legal basis references

tools.name: compare_frameworks
tools.description: Compare KVKK, GDPR, and CCPA requirements side by side to understand overlaps and gaps
